# CLI Evidence: Help

### template --help

```
$ abx template --help
Usage: abx template [options] [command]

Discover, scaffold, build, publish and install sandbox templates.

Examples:
  abx template search python
  abx template scaffold --template python --name my-template
  abx template list

Related commands:
  abx create --template TEMPLATE  Launch a sandbox from a template
  abx deploy [PATH]               Same as 'template deploy'
  abx config --help               Configure credentials and region

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  build       Build Docker image locally, push to ACR, and create a sandbox
              template.
  delete      Delete a custom template from the remote platform.
  deploy      Build, push, and create template in one step (alias of 'template
              build').
  from-image  Create a sandbox template from an existing container image.
  info        Show details for a template ID.
  install     Download a template and (by default) build + deploy it.
  launch      Build/register a template with the selected provider and create a
              sandbox using its returned reference.
  list        List custom templates registered for the current account.
  push        Push a locally-built image to Alibaba Cloud ACR.
  scaffold    Scaffold a new sandbox template project.
  search      Search the template catalog by name, tag, or description.
Exit code: 0
```

### template-list --help

```
$ abx template list --help
Usage: abx template list [options]

List custom templates registered for the current account.

By default this queries the configured platform endpoint. Pass
--official-api to use the Alibaba Cloud FCSandbox API with AK/SK.
This command does not search the community template index.

Examples:
  abx template list
  abx template list --official-api
  abx template list --region cn-shanghai
  abx --json template list

Related commands:
  abx template info TEMPLATE_ID
  abx template search QUERY
  abx template install TEMPLATE_REF

Options:
  --official-api       Query templates via the official Alibaba Cloud FCSandbox
                       API (AK/SK).
  -r, --region <TEXT>  Region override for providers that declare region
                       (otherwise use the provider default)
  -h, --help           Show this message and exit.
Exit code: 0
```

### template-from-image --help

```
$ abx template from-image --help
Usage: abx template from-image [options] <IMAGE>

Create a sandbox template from an existing container image.

Uses the official Alibaba Cloud FCSandbox CreateTemplate API.
Requires AK/SK credentials (set with 'abx config init --build').

Examples:
  abx template from-image registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ns/repo:tag \
    --name my-template
  abx template from-image registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ns/repo:tag \
    --name my-template --team-id team-xxx --cpu 4 --memory 4096
  abx template from-image registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ns/repo:tag \
    --name my-template --envd-inject --generation 1
  abx template from-image registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ns/repo:tag \
    --name my-template --region cn-shanghai

Related commands:
  abx template push IMAGE       Push a local image to ACR first
  abx template info TEMPLATE_ID Inspect the created template
  abx create ID      Launch a sandbox from the template

Options:
  -n, --name <NAME>                        Template name
  --team-id <TEAM_ID>                      Team ID (or env TEAM_ID / E2B_TEAM_ID; auto-resolved if omitted)
  --cpu <FLOAT>                            CPU cores (default 2)
  --memory <INTEGER>                       Memory in MB (default 2048)
  --disk-size <INTEGER>                    Disk size in MB
  --internet-access                        Internet access (default: platform decides)
  --no-internet-access                     Opposite of --internet-access.
  --start-cmd <START_CMD>                  Container start command
  --ready-cmd <READY_CMD>                  Container readiness check command
  --generation <INTEGER>                   Sandbox generation (default 1). 1=first-gen (rund), 2=second-gen MicroVM.
  --force                                  If a generation-1 template with this name already exists, delete it and create it again.
  --envd-inject                            Enable envd injection in build
  --no-envd-inject                         Opposite of --envd-inject.
  --target-image <TARGET_IMAGE>            Destination image ref for envd copy (auto-derived with random suffix if omitted)
  --registry-type <REGISTRY_TYPE>          Registry type (auto-detected from --acree-instance-id) (choices: "acr", "acree")
  --acree-instance-id <ACREE_INSTANCE_ID>  ACR EE instance ID (cri-...)
  --registry-username <REGISTRY_USERNAME>  Registry login username (for pulling image)
  --registry-password <REGISTRY_PASSWORD>  Registry login password (for pulling image)
  -r, --region <TEXT>                      Region override for providers that declare region (otherwise use the provider default)
  -h, --help                               Show this message and exit.
Exit code: 0

### template-build --help

```
$ abx template build --help
Usage: abx template build [options] [TEMPLATE_DIR]

Build Docker image locally, push to ACR, and create a sandbox template.

Full pipeline with cloud side effects: the local docker build is
local-only, but the ACR push and the remote template registration
can incur Alibaba Cloud costs (ACR storage/traffic, template
resources).

Publish path (--build, default auto):

auto: a Dockerfile publishes that image. Otherwise template.yaml build
  steps are sent as CreateTemplate sandboxConfig.steps.
dockerfile: local docker build → ACR push → CreateTemplate. template.yaml
  build steps are not sent.
steps: no local Docker and no ACR push. sandboxConfig.image is base.image
  and sandboxConfig.steps is the expanded build block. Official API only.

Registration API:

--official-api (default):
  dockerfile mode: local docker build → ACR push → official CreateTemplate API.
  Requires AK/SK credentials (set with 'abx config init --build').

--legacy-api:
  local docker build → ACR push → legacy v3/v2 platform API.
  Use --legacy-api to keep the old behaviour.

Requires Docker daemon running and ACR credentials. In automation/CI,
pass --acr-namespace and TEMPLATE_DIR explicitly instead of relying
on ACR_NAMESPACE / ABX_TEMPLATE_DIR environment variables or .env
files, so the build cannot drift with the surrounding environment.

Examples:
  abx template build ./examples/templates/python-hello \
    --acr-namespace my-ns --acr-repo python-hello
  abx template build ./my-template \
    --acr-namespace prod --acree-instance-id cri-xxx
  abx template build ./my-template \
    --acr-namespace prod --disk-size 10240 --internet-access
  abx template build ./my-template \
    --acr-namespace prod --legacy-api
  abx template build ./my-template --acr-namespace prod --region cn-shanghai
  abx template build ./my-template --build steps --yes

Related commands:
  abx template scaffold DIRECTORY    Scaffold template source files
  abx template push IMAGE        Push an existing local image only
  abx create ID       Launch the completed template

Options:
  --acr-registry <ACR_REGISTRY>            ACR registry host
  --acr-namespace <ACR_NAMESPACE>          ACR namespace (env: ACR_NAMESPACE, or set in .env file)
  --acr-repo <ACR_REPO>                    ACR repository name (defaults to template.yaml name or dir name)
  --acr-username <ACR_USERNAME>            ACR login username (default: ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID)
  --acr-password <ACR_PASSWORD>            ACR login password (default: ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET)
  --acree-instance-id <ACREE_INSTANCE_ID>  ACR EE instance ID (cri-...)
  --vpc-id <VPC_ID>                        VPC ID for ACR EE
  --vswitch-ids <VSWITCH_IDS>              Comma-separated VSwitch IDs
  --security-group-id <SECURITY_GROUP_ID>  Security group ID
  -a, --alias <ALIAS>                      Template alias
  -t, --tag <TAG>                          Docker image tag
  --platform <PLATFORM>                    Target platform
  --cpu <INTEGER>                          CPU cores (default: from template.yaml resources.cpu, fallback 2)
  --memory <INTEGER>                       Memory in MB (default: from template.yaml resources.memory, fallback 2048)
  --start-cmd <START_CMD>                  Container start command
  --ready-cmd <READY_CMD>                  Container readiness check command
  --timeout <INTEGER>                      Build timeout in seconds
  -f, --dockerfile <PATH>                  Custom Dockerfile path
  --build <BUILD>                          Publish path: auto (Dockerfile if present, otherwise template.yaml build steps), dockerfile, or steps [default: auto] (choices: "auto", "dockerfile", "steps")
  --disk-size <INTEGER>                    Disk size in MB (official API only)
  --internet-access                        Internet access (default: platform decides; official API only)
  --no-internet-access                     Opposite of --internet-access.
  --official-api                           Use official CreateTemplate API (default) or legacy v3/v2
  --legacy-api                             Opposite of --official-api.
  --team-id <TEAM_ID>                      Team ID for official API (or env TEAM_ID / E2B_TEAM_ID)
  --envd-inject                            Enable envd injection (default False)
  --no-envd-inject                         Opposite of --envd-inject.
  --generation <INTEGER>                   Sandbox generation (default: template.yaml 'generation'; else 2 when the provider starts the server and commands.py exists; else 1). 1=first-gen (rund), 2=second-gen MicroVM.
  --force                                  If a generation-1 template with this name already exists, delete it and create it again. Without --force, deploy stops and prints 'abx template delete <id> -y'.
  --target-image <TARGET_IMAGE>            Destination image ref for envd copy (auto-derived with random suffix if omitted)
  -y, --yes                                Skip confirmation prompt
  -v, --verbose                            Verbose output (DEBUG level)
  -r, --region <TEXT>                      Region override for providers that declare region (otherwise use the provider default)
  -h, --help                               Show this message and exit.
Exit code: 0
```

### template-init --help

```
$ abx template scaffold --help
Usage: abx template scaffold [options] [DIRECTORY]

Scaffold a new sandbox template project.

Creates a ready-to-build template directory with template.yaml,
Dockerfile, and (depending on the case) a commands.py file.
Nothing is built, pushed, deployed, or turned into a sandbox.

When DIRECTORY is omitted a new ./<name> subdirectory is created
(derived from --name, the scaffold case, or the fetched template).

--prompt requests natural-language template generation; DIRECTORY always
names a directory. Template generation (Qwen Code, needs 'abx config init
--llm')
writes Dockerfile, commands.py (the HTTP server) and template.yaml into
./<name>/ and stops. An interactive
terminal is asked for that directory first (Enter keeps ./<name>/).
A path token (my-app, ./my app) stays a directory.

--adopt adapts a project that already has source code and no template
files. Template generation sees a copy, and only Dockerfile, commands.py,
template.yaml and a generated .dockerignore are written back, after you
confirm. Nothing is built or deployed.

Examples:
  abx template scaffold --list                     # List built-in cases
  abx template scaffold -t python                  # Creates ./python/
  abx template scaffold -t python --name myapp     # Creates ./myapp/
  abx template scaffold -t python ./my-template    # Explicit directory
  abx template scaffold --from owner/repo          # Creates ./<template-name>/
  abx template scaffold --prompt "a python data science env"  # generate files
only, no build
  abx template scaffold -y --prompt "a node.js api server"    # non-interactive
generation
  abx template scaffold --adopt . --hint "port 8080" # adapt this project
  abx template scaffold --adopt ./app --dry-run      # show what would be sent

Related commands:
  abx template deploy DIRECTORY
  abx template install TEMPLATE_REF
  abx create TEMPLATE
  abx create --prompt "DESCRIPTION"   # generate, build, deploy, and create

Options:
  --prompt <PROMPT>      Generate a template from a natural-language description
  -t, --template <CASE>  Built-in scaffold case (python, node, minimal)
  --from <FROM_REF>      Fetch template source from a registry ref (owner/repo,
                         local path)
  --name <NAME>          Template name (default: case name, or fetched template
                         name)
  --list                 List available scaffold cases
  --force                Overwrite existing files
  --adopt                Adapt an existing source project: template generation
                         adds the template files (Dockerfile, commands.py,
                         template.yaml). DIRECTORY is the project (default: .).
  --hint <HINT>          With --adopt: what the code cannot tell the generator
                         (ports, services).
  --dry-run              With --adopt: list what would be sent to the model.
                         Nothing is sent or written.
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output (DEBUG level)
  -y, --yes              Skip confirmation prompts: the template directory,
                         description clarification, and (with --adopt) the send
                         and write prompts. Required for non-interactive
                         template generation. Does not build or deploy.
                         Replacing an existing Dockerfile still needs --force
                         when there is no interactive preview.
  --model <MODEL>        Model id for natural-language generation. Overrides
                         llm_model for this command. An interactive terminal
                         offers coding and chat models with the arrow keys when
                         the chosen id does not exist.
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.
Exit code: 0
```

```

### template-install --help

```
$ abx template install --help
Usage: abx template install [options] <TEMPLATE_REF>

Download a template and (by default) build + deploy it.

By default, install downloads the template, then runs docker build,
pushes to ACR, and creates a sandbox template via the official API —
cloud-side operations that can incur Alibaba Cloud costs (ACR
storage/traffic, template resources). Use --download-only to skip the
build/deploy step and only download to the local cache
(~/.abx/templates/).

Use --dir <path> to download into a specific directory instead of
the cache.

TEMPLATE_REF can be a bare template name from the official index
(alibaba-agent-sandbox/awesome-templates) or a registry reference. Bare names
are resolved against the remote index; entries may pin a version, in
which case that pinned ref is honoured.

A GitHub token (private repos / higher rate limits) is taken from
--token, then the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable, then ./.env, then
the stored github_token; prefer 'abx config set github_token' - --token
may leak into shell history and process listings.

Examples:
  abx template install python-hello --download-only   # install by index name
  abx template install owner/repo --acr-namespace my-ns
  abx template install owner/repo@v1.0 --download-only
  abx template install owner/repo//subdir --dir ./local-copy
  abx template install owner/repo --acr-namespace my-ns --region cn-shanghai

Related commands:
  abx template search QUERY  Find a template in the index
  abx template list          List registered templates
  abx create ID   Launch the installed template

Options:
  --registry-url <REGISTRY_URL>    Registry URL (default: GitHub)
  --registry-type <REGISTRY_TYPE>  Registry type (auto-detected if not
                                   specified) (choices: "github", "local")
  --token <TOKEN>                  GitHub token for private repos / higher rate
                                   limits. Prefer 'abx config set github_token'
                                   (masked input, stored once in ~/.abx/.env);
                                   --token is a temporary override that may leak
                                   into shell history and the process list (env:
                                   GITHUB_TOKEN).
  -a, --alias <ALIAS>              Template alias
  --download-only                  Only download to local cache (skip build and
                                   deploy)
  --dir <PATH>                     Download template source into this directory
                                   instead of the cache
  --acr-namespace <ACR_NAMESPACE>  ACR namespace for deploy (env: ACR_NAMESPACE,
                                   or set in .env file)
  --cpu <INTEGER>                  CPU cores (default: from template.yaml or 2)
  --memory <INTEGER>               Memory in MB (default: from template.yaml or
                                   2048)
  -y, --yes                        Skip confirmation prompt
  -r, --region <TEXT>              Region override for providers that declare
                                   region (otherwise use the provider default)
  -h, --help                       Show this message and exit.
Exit code: 0
```
